text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed weird routing for svc-account tokens hitting hosted when they should go to dedicated pool. Repro below.

kevin: Can you paste the request/response headers?

maria: Sure:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sa_tok_abc123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -v
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< x-routing: hosted-region-us
< x-quota-tenant: org:acme
```

jia: That x-quota-tenant header is suspect — looks like we're only resolving org from the token and defaulting route to hosted when project is missing.

olivia: Why would project be missing? SA tokens should carry project_id claim. Did the token mint step drop it?

maria: This token was minted by our internal service-account key broker. Might be using the old v1 mint flow.

ev an: If route falls back to hosted we also skip Dedicated quota checks — means bursts aren't throttled. Could explain recent spike in cost.

sam: For console UX: we should show "effective route" on the API keys page and a "why" link that expands to the resolution path (claims -> mapping -> fallback). Ops needs quick diff between hosted/dedicated enforcement.

jia: Agreed. From infra side I propose a circuit-breaker: if project_id is missing, deny requests to non-admin keys OR force routing to a safe-proxy that enforces quota at edge. Less silent fallback.

maria: +1 to safe-proxy. Also we need telemetry event 'auth.route.resolve' with fields {token_kind, claims_present, mapped_pool, fallback_reason}. That will make dashboards actionable.

auth-bot: I pushed a small patch to staging that logs missing project_id as 'auth.route.resolve:fallback=missing_project' — monitoring alerted.

kevin: Nice. Can we also add a console flag for "treat missing project as deny" (org-admins only)? would help slow rollouts.

olivia: Yep — we can add a per-org policy. UX should default to safe (deny) and let orgs opt-in to permissive routing.

ev an: Let's also add a release note for Dedicated customers; they should be aware of the stricter enforcement.

maria: I'll open an RFC for the mapping fix + circuit-breaker + telemetry. Assigning reviewers: @kevin @jia @olivia.

kevin: I'll take auth-service changes.

jia: I'll own telemetry + console toggle.

sam: I'll wire up the UI mock and admin text.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
